title: 一年有十二个月
subtitle: 日历上的十二格
character: wearing a forest green t-shirt, tan trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in cut-paper calendar style, flat rectangular shapes with clean edges, four seasonal colour families over cream, simple and graphic, slight paper texture

pages.zh:
妈妈在墙上挂了一本新日历。
她说：新的一年开始了。
我数了数，
上面有十二张纸。
为什么是十二张呢？
pages.scene: The little boy stands looking up at a wall calendar that a grown adult woman has just hung, curious.

pages.zh:
因为一年有十二个「月份」。
一月、二月、三月……
一直数到十二月，
一年就过完了，
又从一月重新开始。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: twelve equal rectangles arranged in three rows of four on a cream background, each one plain. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
每个月有多少天呢？
大多数是三十天或三十一天，
只有二月最短，
只有二十八天，
有时候二十九天。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: twelve vertical bars in a row on a cream background, all nearly the same height except the second, which is clearly shorter. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
为什么一年要这么长呢？
因为地球绕太阳一圈，
差不多要这么久。
转完一圈，
就是一年。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one sun in the middle of a cream background with one large circle around it and one small earth on the circle, plus one curved arrow showing the direction. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
十二个月分成四季。
三个月一季：
春、夏、秋、冬。
每一季，
窗外都长得不一样。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: twelve equal rectangles in a row on a cream background, coloured in four groups of three, each group a different shade. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
春天暖起来，
树发芽，花开了。
三月、四月、五月，
是春天。
pages.scene: One bare-branched tree on a cream background sprouting small green buds, with a few flowers at its foot. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
夏天最热，
天黑得最晚。
六月、七月、八月，
白天长长的，
可以在外面玩很久。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two bars side by side on a cream background: a long light one and a short dark one, showing a long day and a short night. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
秋天凉下来，
叶子变黄、变红，
然后掉下来。
九月、十月、十一月，
是收东西的时候。
pages.scene: One tree on a cream background with orange and red leaves, several of them falling to the ground. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
冬天最冷，
天黑得最早。
十二月、一月、二月。
洛杉矶不怎么下雪，
可是早上会很凉。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two bars side by side on a cream background: a short light one and a long dark one, showing a short day and a long night. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
一个月里，
七天算一个星期。
所以日历上
每一行都是七格，
一个月有四行多一点。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one calendar grid on a cream background, seven columns wide and five rows tall, all cells empty. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
生日在哪个月呢？
每个人都不一样。
找到那一页，
数数还有几天，
就知道要等多久。
pages.scene: One calendar page on a cream background with a small star drawn in one of its squares. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我找到了自己生日那一页，
在上面画了一颗星。
还要等好几个月呢。
可是没关系，
日历会一页一页翻过去。
pages.scene: The little boy reaches up and draws a small star on one square of the wall calendar, pleased with himself.
